title: mu_V-a.e. tangent planes and measurability of tangentProj (Simon Ch. 3, Thm 1.9)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) ∧ MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight
